run_amg_mask_generation: run automatic mask generation on an input image or directory of images using a SAM model checkpoint
write_masks_to_folder: write generated segmentation masks to a folder as PNGs with a metadata CSV file
get_amg_kwargs: get automatic mask generator keyword arguments filtered from command-line arguments
run_amg_with_rle_output: run automatic mask generation and save masks as COCO RLEs in a single JSON file
run_amg_with_crop_layers: run automatic mask generation on cropped image scales to produce more detailed masks
